statement: The actual free arithmetic group P=G_(Q(zeta3),{3})^(3) has Frattini field Q(zeta9,cuberoot3). For every inert rational prime ell=8 mod9, its degree-three Frobenius word is x^(3 alpha_ell)[y,[x,y]]^beta_ell modulo D4, where alpha=(ell^2-1)/9 mod3 and beta is the explicit cross-ratio cubic residue. At17 the word is x^6[y,[x,y]]^2, the exact Frattini depth is one, the exact Zassenhaus depth is three, and the nine conjugate Frobenius classes have rank five in the ten-dimensional Frattini quotient. The exact fixed Fox module has cyclic ranks0,1,3,5; the actual finite Galois square map gives relative Dirichlet densities1/81,2/81,8/27,2/3 among ell=8 mod9. Complete residue matrices additionally give ranks3,1,3 at269,809,1187.

notes: The genuine field maps are zeta9->zeta9^4, root3->root3 for x and zeta9->zeta9, root3->zeta3 root3 for y. The two characters determine K1 exactly.

The small cross ratio h uses u=-z^2(1-z)^2 and its cyclotomic conjugate. The exact identities u*u1*u2=3 and ((3-u^3)/(3-u1^3))*gamma=9*q^3 give the literal triple-bracket Kummer comparison, with its sign. The explicit eigenspace argument proves gamma is a noncube before the Heisenberg extension is used.
The Kummer characters zeta9,h are exactly dual to x^3,[y,[x,y]] on the c-fixed part of D3/D4. The character h vanishes on x^3 by its explicit F64 value zeta3^2, whose21st power is one.

Continuous Fox derivatives give Phi/Phi2=ker(R^2->R), R=F3[s,t]/(s^3,t^3). The actual conjugation is (A(X,Y^-1),-Y^-1 B(X,Y^-1)); its four-dimensional fixed space and all81 cyclic submodules are evaluated.
At17 the90 complete Kummer residues give an independent10x9 matrix of rank5 and four independent relations. Every column is nonzero, and the universal group norm annihilates every Fox cycle.
A local c-fixed prolongation is supplied by the actual unramified procyclic local image and the coprime complement theorem. The conjugation preserves the Kummer normalization on3.
